paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC, in percent) of six different methods—Base, MEND, FT, MEMIT, IKE, and ROME—as a function of the co-occurrence number, which is plotted on the x-axis using a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10³ (1000). The y-axis represents accuracy in percent, ranging from 30% to 55%. The 'Base' method is shown as a black line with circle markers, starting at approximately 28.5% and rising to about 32% before leveling off. The 'MEND' method is a brown line with diamond markers, beginning near 36% and increasing to about 45%. The 'FT' method is a blue line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 32% and rising to about 38%. The 'MEMIT' method is a purple line with star markers, beginning near 36% and rising to about 47%. The 'IKE' method is a red line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 32% and rising to about 41%. The 'ROME' method is a green line with square markers, starting at approximately 43% and rising to about 57%.
